summary: SiteDocument is a data class representing the association of documents with a specific site in the HSPnet system. It stores references to a site and a document identifier.
purpose: Represents and associates uploaded or stored documents with a given site for access, display, or management within the HSPnet application.
content_gaps: No information available on workflows, actors, validations, or dependencies beyond basic structure.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is an ASP.NET page and associated code-behind focused on displaying a welcome/summary page for staff administrators. It shows last login data, manages error and warning panels, and provides site and discipline filters for employment applications.
purpose: To provide staff administrators with a summary view including their last login time, error/warning messages, and a current list/filter of employment applications by site, discipline, and date range.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.description: The selected site for filtering applications.

fields.name: DisciplineID
fields.description: The selected discipline for filtering applications.

actors.name: StaffAdmin
actors.description: User accessing the WelcomeStaffAdmin page to review employment applications.

workflows.name: View Employment Applications
steps: StaffAdmin logs in and accesses WelcomeStaffAdmin page.
The system displays last login time and allows selection of site, discipline, subdiscipline, and date range.
StaffAdmin sets filters and clicks 'Refresh View' to update results.
Grid displays applications based on selected criteria, including options to show/hide withdrawn applications.
StaffAdmin can view details, status, and use email links to contact applicants.

business_rules: ShowWithdrawn checkbox determines if withdrawn applications are included.
Date fields require valid input; End Date must not precede Start Date.
Default date range is set to past 3 months.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator ensures start/end dates are set.
ValidationSummary aggregates and displays validation errors.
conditions: If user has no LastLogin value, panel is hidden.
If SiteID query string parameter exists, use it as default filter.
system_behavior: Registers client-side scripts for date and page functionality.
Handles error and warning messages in always-visible floating panels.
Data grid supports paging and empty data handling.
dependencies: HSPnet.UI controls (for data grid, Ajax extenders)
exceptions: If required UserSession is missing, cancels data retrieval.
Handles file not found or delete failures silently in auxiliary code.
content_gaps: No details on EmploymentApplication entity's structure, only its UI presentation.

summary: ServiceCode is an entity representing codes associated with services, including attributes for categorization, localization, sorting, and notes.
purpose: Enable categorization and retrieval of service codes and their descriptions for use in other entities such as courses and timetables.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the service code.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Long description (localized if in alt language mode).

workflows.name: List All Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll with session.
System executes stored procedure 'ServiceCodeListAll' with SessionID.
Reads returned fields into ServiceCode objects, applying localization if needed.
Returns list of ServiceCode objects.

workflows.name: Get Service Codes for Course
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID with session and CourseID.
System executes 'ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID' SP.
Populates list as for all codes, possibly filtered.

workflows.name: Get Service Codes for Timetable
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID with session and TimetableID.
System executes 'ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID' SP.
Populates list as for all codes.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is true, use alternative name/notes fields for localization.
dependencies: Relies on HSPnetSession, database/procedure access, localization settings.
content_gaps: No details of UI or validation logic; no detailed field definitions for CodeCategory.

summary: SiteProfileHistory logs audit entries related to site profile actions. It records changes, including dates, user information, and descriptive captions.
purpose: Track changes and actions performed on site profiles, including which fields were changed, by whom, and when.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the history entry.

fields.name: ActionDate
fields.description: The date/time when the action occurred.

fields.name: ScreenSection
fields.description: Section of the UI where the action was performed.

fields.name: Agency
fields.description: Agency code of the user who performed the action.

fields.name: ByUserID
fields.description: User ID of the person performing the action.

fields.name: ByUserSysAdmin
fields.description: Indicates if the action was performed by a system admin.

fields.name: ActionDateFormatted
fields.description: ActionDate formatted as a short date.

fields.name: AgencyUserFormatted
fields.description: Short string for displaying user/agency info.

actors.name: User
actors.description: Person performing an action that modifies a site profile.

workflows.name: Audit Site Profile Actions
steps: User performs an action that modifies a site profile.
A SiteProfileHistory entry is created recording the action, affected fields, and user details.
History entries can be retrieved by SiteID and viewing agency.

business_rules: If action performed by support team or system admin, display as such in formatted fields.
Phone field is masked depending on localization settings.
system_behavior: SiteProfileHistories.SiteProfileHistorySearch retrieves history entries for a site.
UI component disables data retrieval if session is missing.
dependencies: Depends on HSPnetSession, NameFormatter, Phone utility, localization settings.
exceptions: Data retrieval is cancelled if session is not present.
content_gaps: No UI details for displaying histories; Phone and NameFormatter class details not provided.

summary: EmailPopupDocument represents documents used in email popups, mainly for selection/deletion by users in a UI context. The supporting logic allows searching for and deleting document references.
purpose: Allows users to view, select, and manage documents (by file path/name) associated with email functionalities, including deletion from storage.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the popup document.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.description: Full file path used for file operations.

fields.name: Checked
fields.description: Selected status in UI; indicates if the document is marked/checked for an operation.

actors.name: User
actors.description: User selecting or deleting popup documents in the UI.

workflows.name: Search Documents
steps: User triggers a search with DataInfo parameter.
System parses DataInfo and splits into documents.
Each document's filename and path is used to create EmailPopupDocument entries.

workflows.name: Delete Document
steps: User triggers a delete by specifying DataInfo and target ID.
System parses DataInfo, deletes the target file by path, and possibly its containing folder.
Returns updated DataInfo string without the deleted entry.

business_rules: If deleting a document, attempt to delete the file and the containing folder.
conditions: If file/folder delete throws, exceptions are swallowed (not propagated).
system_behavior: Search and delete behaviors for email documents; UI not specified but implied.
dependencies: HSPnet.Framework, HSPnet.App_GlobalResources for session and resources.
exceptions: File or folder delete exceptions are caught and ignored.
content_gaps: No details on actual UI triggers or displays; limited to backend logic as shown.
